# Roman title names: see common/scripted_effects/LR/LR_roman_title_names_effects.txt
# Generated by tools/roman_title_names/gen_roman_title_names.py (936 workspace).

on_game_start_after_lobby = {
	on_actions = { LR_roman_title_names_game_start }
}
on_title_gain = {
	on_actions = { LR_roman_title_names_on_title_gain }
}
on_character_culture_change = {
	on_actions = { LR_roman_title_names_on_holder_change }
}
yearly_playable_pulse = {
	on_actions = { LR_roman_title_names_on_holder_change }
}
# vanilla's on_vassal_change resets a new vassal's primary title name; rename the day after
on_vassal_change = {
	on_actions = { LR_roman_title_names_on_vassal_change }
}

# root = the new holder, scope:title = the title
LR_roman_title_names_on_title_gain = {
	trigger = {
		scope:title = { LR_roman_named_title_trigger = yes }
	}
	effect = {
		scope:title = { LR_roman_title_names_refresh_effect = yes }
	}
}

# root = a character
LR_roman_title_names_on_holder_change = {
	trigger = {
		any_held_title = { LR_roman_named_title_trigger = yes }
	}
	effect = { LR_roman_title_names_refresh_held_effect = yes }
}

# root = the vassal
LR_roman_title_names_on_vassal_change = {
	trigger = {
		any_held_title = { LR_roman_named_title_trigger = yes }
	}
	effect = {
		trigger_event = { on_action = LR_roman_title_names_on_holder_change days = 1 }
	}
}
